report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Vikram Singh | Age: 49
Body Temperature at Scene: 26.7°C | Ambient Temperature: 21.3°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 8.2 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  2. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  3. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  4. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  5. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Ethanol, Opiates, Chloroform

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
